injuries.name: Bowen Byram
injuries.note: Byram remains day-to-day and will miss his second straight game. He has additional time to recover, with Chicago not scheduled to play until Friday against Montreal. Byram has one assist, five shots on goal, nine blocked shots and two hits in six appearances this season.

injuries.name: Oskar Back
injuries.note: Back exited Wednesday's game against the Avalanche and was placed on injured reserve Friday. He's slated to miss at least a month after being diagnosed with a broken finger, and it's possible the Stars move him to long-term injured reserve at some point.

injuries.name: Matt Duchene
injuries.note: The Stars placed Duchene on long-term injured reserve just before the start of the 2026-27 campaign. It remains unclear when he will return, but his new timeline could keep him out until at least mid-January. Duchene posted 16 goals, 45 points and 89 shots on net in 57 regular-season appearances for Dallas in 2025-26.
